topDecks.name: Amethyst/Steel (Shift Combo)
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: The breakout deck of the Attack of the Vine! CCQ season. Two distinct variants: Maleficent & Diablo - Evil Incarnate Shift build (Brandon Bolen, won Vans CCQ) and Omnidroid/Syndrome - Out for Revenge build (three Top 8 finishes at Millennium Games CCQ). Both use Shift to fuel card advantage. Maleficent & Diablo draws a card the moment it enters and every subsequent turn.
keyCards: Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem
topDecks.gameplan: Variant A (Shift/Maleficent & Diablo): Flood the discard with Shift targets. Deploy Maleficent & Diablo - Evil Incarnate for immediate card draw. Alert characters punish Evasive strategies. Variant B (Omnidroid): Chain Omnidroid Shifts, then Syndrome - Out for Revenge replays them for free when banished. Both aim to win turns 4-6 via overwhelming card advantage.
strengths: Maleficent & Diablo draws a card immediately on entry — never a dead play
Alert removes Evasive characters that other strategies can't touch
Syndrome - Out for Revenge enables free Omnidroid replays for tempo
Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem hard-counters Ruby/Sapphire item strategies
Two distinct build variants both winning high-level events
weaknesses: Needs critical mass of discard to power Maleficent & Diablo effectively
Omnidroid build loses steam if Syndrome is removed early
Less explosive than pure aggro turns 1-2
topDecks.mulligan: Keep any 1-2 cost Shift target (Violet Parr, Morph - Little Imitator, Angel) plus a 3-4 drop. Discard Maleficent & Diablo to load discard count early.

topDecks.name: Amber/Ruby Boost (Boosties)
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: Won CCQ Warehouse 51 Games (Humble). Attack of the Vine! gave this deck Sulley - The New Boss and Sulley & Boo - Scare Buddies. Sulley shifts into Scare Buddies; when Scare Buddies is banished after Raging Storm, Sulley replays for free and draws a card. This violates Raging Storm's intended design. Webby's Diary + Medallion Weights are the draw engine. Gaston - Superior Archer and Red Alert add a powerful removal package.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 1-3: Establish Webby's Diary / Medallion Weights draw engine. Turn 4: Shift Sulley - New Boss into Sulley & Boo - Scare Buddies. Cast Raging Storm — Scare Buddies is banished, Sulley - New Boss replays for free and you draw a card. Scrooge's Counting House starves opponent of lore. Maleficent - Monstrous Dragon closes.
strengths: Sulley & Boo + Raging Storm: free board wipe plus free Sulley replay plus draw a card
Gaston - Superior Archer and Red Alert cover both aggro and control matchups
Webby's Diary / Medallion Weights extremely consistent card draw
Counting House denies opponent lore during mid-game
weaknesses: Setup-heavy — needs Diary/Weights to function smoothly
Can fall behind if early characters are removed before Sulley arrives
Slightly weaker into ultra-fast aggro
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Webby's Diary or Medallion Weights. Any hand with early draw plus Sulley - New Boss is strong.

topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald (Elinor Aggro)
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: Won CCQ Millennium Games. Multiple sub-variants — no consensus build yet. Core package: Aurora - Holding Court to jumpstart early Elinor - Renowned Diplomat. Mulan - Resourceful Recruit (new from Attack of the Vine!) is the breakout card — buff her with Dale - Ready For His Shot and Snow Fort and she quests for 3+ lore as a Princess demanding an immediate answer.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 1-2: Deploy cheap 1-2 cost characters. Turn 3-4: Elinor - Renowned Diplomat stacks card advantage — multiple copies are exponential. Buff Mulan with Snow Fort / Dale for 3+ lore per quest while she demands answers. Ursula - Deceiver strips opponent responses.
strengths: Elinor - Renowned Diplomat is crushing in multiples
Mulan - Resourceful Recruit is a must-answer threat that quests for massive lore
Multiple build variants make preparation difficult
Aurora doubles as ramp for Princess synergies
weaknesses: Weaker if Elinor is efficiently countered before she fires
No consensus build — format still maturing
Amethyst/Steel trades efficiently against the flood strategy
topDecks.mulligan: Keep any 1-2 drop plus Aurora - Holding Court. Ideal: Aurora plus Pocahontas plus Elinor.

topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald (Prison Control)
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: 2nd Place Vans CCQ and Top 8 Millennium Games CCQ. Prison/control variant of the same color pair. Hampers opponent's hand with Ursula - Deceiver and Lenny - Toy Binoculars, then clears repeatedly with Chernabog - Unnatural Force, Milo Thatch - Getting His Hands Dirty, and the Malicious, Mean and Scary + Prince Phillip - Vanquisher of Foes combo.
keyCards: Milo Thatch - Getting His Hands Dirty
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 1-3: Deploy Ursula - Deceiver and Lenny - Toy Binoculars to strip hand. Turn 4+: Chernabog + Milo Thatch as recurring board sweepers. Malicious, Mean and Scary + Prince Phillip combo locks the field. Stitch + Circle of Life close with lore.
strengths: Grinds out any deck relying on card advantage
Prince Phillip + Malicious combo is very hard to break out of
Layers of hand disruption plus board wipes
weaknesses: Slow setup — ultra-fast decks can race it
Relies on executing combos in order
Weaker if hand disruption pieces are removed early
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Ursula - Deceiver and any early hand disruption. Ideal: Hand stripper plus a sweeper in hand.

topDecks.name: Sapphire/Steel (Darkwing Duck Detective)
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: Top 4 at both Vans CCQ and Warehouse 51 CCQ (Ezekiel Murphy). Detective-class deck running 16 Darkwing Duck variants — no Tipo/Sail ramp. Judy Hopps - Lead Detective enables free challenges that punish anyone who quests. Nick Wilde - Persistent Investigator, Pluto - Steel Champion, and Darkwing Duck & Launchpad - St. Canard's Finest are the payoffs. Budget-friendly (~$180, of which $150 is Angel - Experiment 624).
keyCards: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad - St. Canard's Finest
The Terror That Flaps in the Night
topDecks.gameplan: Flood with cheap Darkwing / Launchpad Detective bodies. Judy Hopps - Lead Detective enables free challenges every time the opponent quests. Nick Wilde and Pluto generate value from challenges. Darkwing Duck & Launchpad finish as a top-end threat. The Terror That Flaps in the Night deals chip damage without additional ink.
strengths: Extremely punishing against questing — Judy Hopps triggers free challenges every time
Alert handles Evasive threats efficiently
16 Darkwing variants give high consistency and synergy density
Budget-friendly if Angels are already owned
weaknesses: Less raw power against pure control shells
No ramp means slightly slower curve
Opponent can position to avoid profitable challenges
topDecks.mulligan: Keep any Darkwing Duck plus Judy Hopps - Lead Detective. Two Darkwing variants is the ideal opening.

topDecks.name: Amber/Ruby Toys
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: Top 4 Vans CCQ (Dylan Brown). Budget deck (~$60, no card over $4 including Legendaries). Woody - Helping A Friend (new from Attack of the Vine!) adds to the Toy card-flow engine alongside Jessie - Lively Cowgirl and Woody - Leader Of The Toys. Sid Phillips - Toy Surgeon provides fast lore close.
topDecks.gameplan: Deploy cheap Toys aggressively for early questing. Woody - Leader Of The Toys and Jessie generate free cards when Toys are played. Woody - Helping A Friend adds Toy card flow. Sid Phillips - Toy Surgeon provides fast lore effect to close near 20.
strengths: Extremely budget-friendly — under $60 to build
Toy synergies generate card advantage without dedicated draw spells
Sid Phillips - Toy Surgeon is a fast lore closer
Resilient mid-game with character flooding
weaknesses: Telegraphed strategy — experienced players know the lines
Weaker into mass board removal
Less raw power than S-tier decks
topDecks.mulligan: Keep cheap Toy characters and Woody. Ideal: Turn 1 Toy plus Woody ready to leverage it.

topDecks.name: Amber/Amethyst Midrange
topDecks.format: Core Constructed (Post-Rotation, Attack of the Vine! era)
topDecks.description: Multiple successful variants in the first CCQs: Evasive-heavy midrange (Top 8 Warehouse 51) and Storm Control running Raging Storm + Junior Woodchuck Guidebook + Ohana Means Family (2nd Vans CCQ). Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan provides stats and stability.
keyCards: Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
topDecks.gameplan: Variant A (Evasive Midrange): Deploy Evasive threats backed by Demona. Variant B (Storm Control): Control early board, refill with Guidebook + Ohana Means Family, sweep with Raging Storm, close with threats.
strengths: Raging Storm is a clean reset against any flood strategy
Two variants make preparation by opponents difficult
Demona provides strong board presence
weaknesses: Less consistent than top-tier decks
Storm Control loses tempo during sweep execution
Evasive variant weaker into heavy removal
topDecks.mulligan: Keep early curve plus Guidebook (Storm) or Evasive threat (midrange).

topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald Dogs (Pre-Rotation / Infinity)
topDecks.description: The pre-rotation Core boogeyman — still S-tier in Infinity. 2nd Place DLC Indianapolis (IMP_Alphos). New Infinity tech: Kida - Protector of Atlantis + Kida - Atlantean for Under the Sea in any matchup; Elinor - Renowned Diplomat for card advantage; The Queen - Devious Disguise as an Evasive threat that dodges removal and quests for 3. Core Dogs engine unchanged.
topDecks.gameplan: Flood board turns 1-3. Grandmother Willow accelerates to Tramp - Street-Smart Dog. Kida - Protector of Atlantis shifts in to shrink board before Under the Sea sweeps. Elinor and The Queen generate card advantage. Under the Sea closes via singer discount.
strengths: Kida package powers Under the Sea in any matchup
Elinor - Renowned Diplomat is backbreaking in multiples
The Queen - Devious Disguise dodges removal and quests for 3
Core aggressive plan proven across dozens of high-level events
weaknesses: Amethyst/Emerald Tempo favorable via Diablo + Snow Fort (Infinity)
Ruby/Sapphire Shark resets with repeated sweepers
Amber/Steel Singer punishes via Cinderella singers + removal songs
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Grandmother Willow, cheap dogs, Kida - Atlantean. Mulligan all hands without a turn 1-2 play.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Sapphire Control (Pre-Rotation)
topDecks.format: Pre-Rotation Core reference — see Infinity section for current viability
topDecks.description: Pre-rotation top deck. Tipo + Sail ramp into Genie - Wish Fulfilled, Dumbo, Demona - Betrayer of the Clan (4-of), and Hades. Featured Swordplay for +3 challenge math vs Dogs. Remains a strong Infinity option but largely displaced in post-rotation Core by Attack of the Vine! archetypes.
keyCards: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
topDecks.gameplan: Ramp → card advantage → finishers. Demona - Betrayer of the Clan as 4-of for Dogs resistance.
strengths: Highest card quality in pre-rotation format
Multiple card advantage engines
weaknesses: Post-rotation legality uncertain for key ramp pieces in Core
Meta shifted significantly with Attack of the Vine!
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo or Sail the Azurite Sea.

topDecks.name: Emerald/Sapphire Control (Pre-Rotation)
topDecks.description: Pre-rotation: Won DLC Taipei (Edmond Chiu). Accelerates ink, draws with Clarabelle, slams haymakers. The Under the Sea + Malicious, Mean and Scary pivot vs Dogs — combined with Ink Geyser after shifted Prince Phillip — was the key adaptation.
topDecks.gameplan: Ramp → Clarabelle card advantage → John Silver lore denial → Under the Sea sweep → Prince Phillip shifted + Ink Geyser lock.
strengths: Ink Geyser + Prince Phillip post-shift is backbreaking
Under the Sea + Prince Phillip package reliably beats Dogs
weaknesses: Post-rotation legality uncertain for core pieces
Vulnerable early if ramp is disrupted
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo, Sail, or John Silver. Must have a turn-2 play.

topDecks.name: Amber/Steel (Pre-Rotation)
topDecks.description: Pre-rotation: Emerged at DLC Ghent as a Dogs counter and won the CCS $25k Invitational Qualifier. Angel - Experiment 624 hard-counters Dogs. Akood Et Emuti enables turn-2 Angel via Cinderella - Ballroom Sensation or Angel - Siren Singer.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 2: Angel - Experiment 624 via Akood Et Emuti. Angel discards and removes cheap Dog threats. Grandmother Willow lets key threats dodge Under the Sea.
strengths: Angel - Experiment 624 hard-counters Dogs
Ignores Under the Sea via Grandmother Willow
weaknesses: Post-rotation viability uncertain
Less resilient without Angel on board
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Angel - Siren Singer or Cinderella - Dream Come True plus Akood Et Emuti.

playTips: Core Constructed has rotated — Attack of the Vine! era is live. Format is healthily diverse across aggro, midrange, combo, and control. No single dominant deck.
Amethyst/Steel has TWO viable builds: Maleficent & Diablo - Evil Incarnate Shift build and Omnidroid/Syndrome - Out for Revenge combo. Know which you face.

Amber/Ruby Boosties key line: Sulley - New Boss shifts into Sulley & Boo - Scare Buddies. After Raging Storm wipes the board and banishes Scare Buddies, Sulley - New Boss replays for FREE and you draw a card. This breaks Raging Storm's intended design.
Darkwing Duck Detective (Sapphire/Steel) punishes questing — do NOT quest blindly into a board of cheap Darkwings with Judy Hopps - Lead Detective in play.

Mulan - Resourceful Recruit (new from Attack of the Vine!) in Amber/Emerald Elinor Aggro: buff her with Snow Fort or Dale - Ready For His Shot and she quests for 3+ lore as a Princess demanding an immediate answer.
Gaston - Superior Archer (new from Attack of the Vine!) is the go-to removal for large control targets. Red Alert handles aggro. Both appear across Amber/Ruby and Amber/Emerald lists.
Morph - Little Imitator (new from Attack of the Vine!) is a key Shift target in Amethyst/Steel — cheap body that doubles as Shift fodder and loads the discard.
In Infinity format: Amethyst/Emerald Tempo (Diablo-based) is the consensus best purple deck. Diablo - Devoted Herald + Snow Fort + 12 Shift targets (8 hit on turn 2) is the core package.
Ruby/Sapphire Shark won DLC Indianapolis. Olaf - Snowman of Action is the new engine — inkable and drains lore massively after Be Prepared. Multiple Olaf after a sweep is game-ending.
Amber/Emerald Dogs Infinity tech: Kida - Protector of Atlantis + Kida - Atlantean enable Under the Sea in ANY matchup. The Queen - Devious Disguise dodges removal and quests for 3 in race scenarios.
Hiram Flaversham - Toymaker is still banned in Core Constructed. Verify deck lists before events.
Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem in Amethyst/Steel is excellent item hate against Ruby/Sapphire builds in both Core and Infinity.

Pull the Lever! / Wrong Lever! in Amethyst/Emerald Infinity: discarding Pull the Lever! to Shift Diablo turns Wrong Lever! into unconditional removal — effectively 6 copies of Friends on the Other Side.
Attack of the Vine! Set Championships approximately 5 weeks from Jul 29, 2026 — now is the time to pick a deck and get reps.
Format Coconut (new Commander-like multiplayer format) announced by Ravensburger — not in official play yet but worth tracking for upcoming seasons.

metaPairings.assessment: Even to slightly favored post-Taipei tech
metaPairings.plan: Mulligan for Tipo/Sail + John Silver. Look for Under the Sea + Malicious, Mean and Scary pivot. Ink Geyser after a shifted Prince Phillip - Vanquisher of Foes is usually a win.
Prioritize ramp leads and don't let their Demona - Betrayer of the Clan snowball. Clarabelle needs to fire before their Demona turns.
Force Angel - Experiment 624 off board early. Use Mowgli - Man Cub to strip Angel or cost pieces to prevent her landing. Grandmother Willow shrinks opponent's hand so they cannot reload Angel.
Sequence threats to bait removal before deploying Tramp - Street-Smart Dog and Under the Sea turns. Avoid wide boards into Strength of a Raging Fire.
Turn-2 Angel - Experiment 624 via Akood Et Emuti or Angel - Siren Singer. Use Angel to systematically discard and remove cheap dogs. Grandmother Willow lets key threats dodge Under the Sea.
Apply pressure before Clarabelle. Goliath - Clan Leader ruins any profitable Clarabelle activation. Dodge Under the Sea with Grandmother Willow on key threats.

Include Swordplay for +3 challenge math. Run Demona - Betrayer of the Clan as 4-of. Limit Genie - Wish Fulfilled copies to reduce Under the Sea blowout potential. Isis Vanderchill can be played to exert key bodies and buy time.
Goliath - Clan Leader is the key: deny Dogs' card advantage engine. Jasmine - Steady Strategist dodges He Hurled His Thunderbolt. Sequence removal efficiently on lore-burst threats.
Trade aggressively early and stack removal. Keep Strength of a Raging Fire for Tramp - Street-Smart Dog or wide boards. Genie - Magical Researcher wins any long game.
Race to lore 20 before their stabilization lands. Turn 5 close-out is required — if you don't win by then, you likely lose.
No good line exists against their efficient trading — consider sideboarding or a different deck for this matchup.

comboPackages.name: Ink Geyser + Prince Phillip Lock
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Shift Prince Phillip then cast Ink Geyser to deplete opponent's ink. Combined with a board sweep, this usually ends the game. The key Dogs-beating sequence confirmed at DLC Taipei.
comboPackages.counterplay: Counter by preventing Prince Phillip from shifting or keeping enough ink to respond. Some Dog lists run Mowgli to strip the Ink Geyser from hand.

comboPackages.name: Grandmother Willow Into Under the Sea
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Turn 3 Grandmother Willow dumps hand perfectly, enables consistent Turn 3 Tramp - Street-Smart Dog and finds Lilo - Escape Artist for Under the Sea. Rhino - One-Sixteenth Wolf shrinks targets into Under the Sea range.
comboPackages.counterplay: Destroy Grandmother Willow immediately. Without her the deck loses its consistency engine. Cards that discard (Mowgli, Ursula - Deceiver) can strip Under the Sea before it fires.

comboPackages.name: Akood Et Emuti Shift Engine
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Sing Akood Et Emuti on turn 2 via Cinderella or Angel - Siren Singer. Enables turn-2 Angel - Experiment 624 or turn-3 Stitch - Carefree Snowboarder. Dramatically accelerates tempo in the early game.
comboPackages.counterplay: Deny the singers before Akood Et Emuti resolves. Once Angel - Experiment 624 lands on turn 2, it is very hard to remove efficiently.

comboPackages.name: Guidebook Value Chain
cards: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Maintains card flow while deploying resilient midgame threats. Demona - Betrayer of the Clan now run as a 4-of for maximum Dogs resistance.
comboPackages.counterplay: Pressure their setup turns. Under the Sea on Genie/Dumbo is crippling. Mowgli strips Guidebook from hand.

comboPackages.name: Beast's Castle Diablo Engine
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Beast's Castle enables characters to quest AND challenge without choosing. Diablo into Beast's Castle turns any challenge into free lore. Hercules/Beast resist taking damage when challenging parked in the location.
comboPackages.counterplay: Target the location — destroy Beast's Castle and the deck loses its primary engine. The archetype has few answers to dedicated location removal.

comboPackages.name: Amethyst/Steel Fighter Chain
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Establishes efficient trading board that denies aggro strategies lore-scoring windows. Genie - Magical Researcher steals games if not immediately removed.
comboPackages.counterplay: Play around Strength of a Raging Fire timing by deploying threats one at a time. Remove Genie - Magical Researcher immediately.

comboPackages.name: Enigmatic Inkcaster Flood
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Triggers Enigmatic Inkcaster twice per turn with a flood of 1-costs for explosive lore generation.
comboPackages.counterplay: Remove Enigmatic Inkcaster immediately — the deck has no backup win condition without it.

infinity.note: Infinity fully validated by DLC Dortmund (Jun 6-7, 2026) and DLC Indianapolis (Jun 20-21, 2026). DLC Manila (Jul 11-12) was the final Infinity DLC of Season 2. Results: Amethyst/Emerald Tempo won Dortmund Grand Final; Ruby/Sapphire Shark won Indianapolis. Amber/Emerald Dogs remains S-tier despite not winning either event final. All sets 1-14 legal in Infinity.

topDecks.name: Ruby/Sapphire Shark
topDecks.description: Won DLC Indianapolis (Bryan Pereira / Splooshmcgoo). Stabilizes with Maui - Hero to All, Firefly Swarm, and Sisu sweepers, then closes with multiple Olaf - Snowman of Action draining lore after Be Prepared. Olaf - Snowman of Action (from Wilds Unknown) is the new key card — inkable and pulls multiple lore back post-sweep.
topDecks.gameplan: Ramp with Tipo/Sail. Draw with Pawpsicle + Merlin's Carpetbag + Tamatoa. Stabilize with Maui - Hero to All and Sisu/Firefly Swarm sweepers. Sweep with Be Prepared then flood with multiple Olaf - Snowman of Action to drain opponent lore. A Pirate's Life closes.
strengths: Olaf - Snowman of Action is inkable and drains massive lore after Be Prepared
Multiple sweeper variants cover all threat types
Maui - Half-Shark loops actions for near-infinite value
Draw engine is extremely consistent
weaknesses: Setup-heavy — needs ramp and draw before executing
Vulnerable to hand disruption before key pieces arrive
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo or Sail the Azurite Sea. Ideal: Ramp piece plus Pawpsicle or Tamatoa.

topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald Dogs
topDecks.description: 2nd Place DLC Indianapolis (IMP_Alphos). Most-played Infinity archetype. New innovations: Kida - Protector of Atlantis + Kida - Atlantean for Under the Sea in any matchup; Elinor - Renowned Diplomat for card advantage; The Queen - Devious Disguise as Evasive lore-questing threat that dodges removal and quests for 3.
topDecks.gameplan: Flood board turns 1-3. Grandmother Willow accelerates to Tramp - Street-Smart Dog. Kida - Protector of Atlantis shifts in to shrink opposing board before Under the Sea sweeps. Elinor and The Queen generate card advantage and lore pressure.
strengths: Kida package powers Under the Sea in any matchup
Elinor - Renowned Diplomat is backbreaking in multiples
The Queen - Devious Disguise dodges removal and quests for 3
Core aggressive plan proven across many high-level events
weaknesses: Amethyst/Emerald Tempo favorable via Diablo + Snow Fort
Ruby/Sapphire Shark resets with repeated sweepers
Amber/Steel Singer punishes via Princess singers + removal songs
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Grandmother Willow, cheap dogs, Kida - Atlantean. Mulligan all hands without a turn 1-2 play.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Emerald Tempo
topDecks.description: Won DLC Dortmund Grand Final (Alessandro Danesi). 3rd Place DLC Indianapolis (Ramen — 5 cards different). De facto purple deck in Infinity. Built around Diablo - Devoted Herald with 12 Shift targets; 8 can Shift Diablo on turn 2. Snow Fort keeps Diablo out of Let the Storm Rage On range. Pull the Lever!/Wrong Lever! chain creates 6 copies of Friends on the Other Side.
keyCards: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 2: Shift Diablo via one of 8 turn-2 Shift targets. Snow Fort keeps Diablo out of removal range. Pull the Lever! discards to shift; Wrong Lever! becomes removal. Dumbo/Genie/Elsa/Peter Pan all draw cards. So Be It! eliminates Ruby/Sapphire items. Under the Sea sweeps aggressive boards.
strengths: Diablo draws cards every turn once established
Snow Fort blocks critical damage-based removal on Diablo
Pull the Lever!/Wrong Lever! combo = 6 copies of Friends on the Other Side
So Be It! is dedicated no-questions-asked item removal
Under the Sea handles aggro identical to Core Constructed
weaknesses: Non-damage removal hard-counters Diablo
Less explosive than Dogs on turns 1-3
Indianapolis showed list still being refined (Sabotage vs So Be It! debate)
topDecks.mulligan: Keep any 2-cost Shift target plus Diablo - Obedient Raven or Diablo - Devoted Herald. Turn-2 Diablo is the ideal line.

topDecks.name: Amber/Steel Singer
topDecks.description: Won DLC Dortmund Saturday (Alex Kuik). Princess-heavy singer shell with full 4x each of the three most efficient Steel songs. Aurora - Holding Court and Cinderella - Ballroom Sensation enable early songs. Beast - Tragic Hero and Cinderella - Stouthearted as finishers. Beyond the Horizon preferred over A Whole New World to avoid refilling opponent's hand.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 2-3: Cinderella or Ariel enable early Steel removal songs. Aurora ramps multiple princess plays per turn. Beast - Tragic Hero dominates with stats + card draw. Cinderella - Stouthearted provides sticky threat. The Bare Necessities answers Be Prepared and Under the Sea.
strengths: Full 4x each of top Steel removal songs guarantees interaction
Aurora enables multiple princess plays simultaneously
Beast - Tragic Hero card draw dominates the mid-game board
The Bare Necessities is critical tech vs Be Prepared and Under the Sea in Infinity
weaknesses: Slightly soft into slower Sapphire control shells
Needs singers alive for song discount engine
Be Prepared disrupts midgame if not answered
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Cinderella - Ballroom Sensation plus Steel removal song. Ideal: Singer plus Aurora plus removal.

topDecks.name: Ruby/Sapphire Items
topDecks.description: 2nd Place both DLC Dortmund heats (Dillon Leduc / Rafaelo Sarmiento). 30+ items, Oswald - The Lucky Rabbit as engine. Maurice's Workshop generates card advantage for every item played. Lucky Dime + Tamatoa - So Shiny! is the game-winning activation. Scrooge McDuck - Resourceful Miser becomes a free 4/4 at item density.
topDecks.gameplan: Establish Maurice's Workshop. Flood items via Oswald engine (30 items = near-guaranteed hits). Workshop replaces each item. Scrooge - Resourceful Miser becomes free at item density. Tamatoa - Happy as a Clam recycles Pawpsicles. Lucky Dime + Tamatoa - So Shiny! is the win condition.
strengths: Maurice's Workshop generates absurd card advantage at item density
Oswald hits nearly every shuffle with 30+ items
Scrooge - Resourceful Miser becomes a free 4/4 early
Sisu provides both early board control and late sweeps
weaknesses: So Be It! (Amethyst/Emerald) and Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem (Amethyst/Steel) are targeted item hate
Setup-heavy — weak to aggressive starts before Workshop lands
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Maurice's Workshop or Oswald - The Lucky Rabbit. Any item plus Workshop is a strong keep.
